settings.page.general.title: General
settings.page.general.desc: Launcher behavior, indexing and file search.
settings.theme.label: Theme
settings.theme.desc: "System" follows the Windows light/dark setting and applies immediately
settings.language.label: Language
settings.language.desc: UI language; "System" uses the Windows display language and falls back to English
settings.hotkey.label: Global hotkey
settings.hotkey.desc: Tauri syntax, e.g. Alt+Space, Ctrl+Shift+Space (on macOS, Alt is the Option key)
settings.maxResults.label: Max results
settings.hideOnBlur.label: Hide on blur
settings.hideOnBlur.desc: Collapse the search box when another window is clicked
settings.alwaysOnTop.label: Always on top
settings.alwaysOnTop.desc: Keep the search box above other windows
settings.tool.screenshot.label: Screenshot
settings.tool.screenshot.desc: Show Screenshot in Tools when the search box is empty
settings.tool.clipboard.label: Clipboard
settings.tool.clipboard.desc: Show clipboard history in Tools when the search box is empty
settings.tool.lock.label: Lock screen
settings.tool.lock.desc: Show Lock screen in Tools when the search box is empty
settings.tool.tile.label: Window actions
settings.tool.tile.desc: Open a menu for tiling, half-screen, minimize others/all, or undo the last tiling
settings.tool.shortcut.label: Shortcut guide
settings.tool.shortcut.desc: Detect the app under the search box and list its shortcuts
settings.tools.hint: Checked tools appear in the panel. Add apps and plugins from their search result with "Add to pinned tools".
settings.index.count.label: Index entries
settings.index.sources.label: Index sources
settings.index.refresh.label: Auto refresh
settings.index.refresh.desc: Interval in seconds; 0 means manual rebuild only
settings.index.registry.label: Registry indexing
settings.index.registry.desc: Read product names and install locations from uninstall entries
settings.index.dirs.label: Scan install folders
settings.index.dirs.desc: Index bare exe files under Program Files and similar folders
settings.index.extra.label: Custom index folders
settings.index.extra.desc: Additionally index .exe / .lnk / .url in these folders (requires "Scan install folders")
settings.bookmarks.label: Search bookmarks
settings.bookmarks.desc: Search Chrome / Edge bookmarks; Enter opens them in the default browser
settings.bookmarks.hint: Only local bookmark files from each profile are read; nothing is uploaded. Changes apply on the next search.
settings.everything.state.label: Status
settings.everything.es.label: es.exe
settings.everything.app.label: Everything app
settings.everything.hint: File search relies on the Everything command-line tool es.exe (verified with sha256 after the official download). After installing the Everything app, click "Check again" once.
settings.command.enabled.label: Enable search-box commands
settings.command.enabled.desc: Run a command directly after the prefix, e.g. >ipconfig; other search sources are skipped
settings.command.prefix.label: Command prefix
settings.command.prefix.desc: Up to 4 symbols; no letters, digits or whitespace (to avoid hijacking normal search)
settings.command.shell.label: Shell
settings.command.path.label: Shell path
settings.command.path.desc: Leave empty for auto-discovery; required for a custom shell
settings.command.distro.label: WSL distro
settings.command.distro.desc: Leave empty to use the default distro
settings.command.args.label: Custom argument template
settings.command.args.desc: Only for the Custom shell; {cmd} is replaced by the command, otherwise the command is appended
settings.command.timeout.label: Timeout (seconds)
settings.command.timeout.desc: 1 - 60; the child process is killed on timeout
settings.command.mode.label: Result display
settings.command.mode.desc: Inline: output returns to the dropdown for copying; Terminal: opens a separate window (for interactive programs)
settings.command.hint: Commands run with your current account privileges; pipes, redirection and environment variables depend on the selected shell. Press Esc to cancel while running.
settings.page.plugins.title: Plugins
settings.page.plugins.desc: Plugins are described by efto-plugin.json and copied into the data folder on import.
settings.import.label: Import plugin
settings.import.desc: Choose a plugin folder or .zip archive; the root must contain efto-plugin.json.
settings.import.hint: Plugin folder / .zip supported; files are copied to plugins under the data folder and existing plugins are not overwritten.
settings.plugin.desc: Running plugins stay resident in the backend and are reused when invoked.
settings.page.runtime.title: Runtime
settings.page.runtime.desc: Let plugins run scripts with Node.js / Python. Only interpreters that pass the check are used.
settings.runtime.node.guide: Node.js not installed? Download the LTS installer from the official site, then click Check (the installer adds Node.js to PATH by default).
settings.runtime.python.guide: Python not installed? Download the installer from the official site, tick "Add python.exe to PATH" during setup, then click Check.
settings.runtime.hint: After saving and passing the check, plugins can call efto.node.run / efto.python.run. The interpreter path can only be set here; plugins cannot specify or replace programs. When left empty, efto auto-detects an interpreter from the system PATH at startup.
settings.page.models.title: Models
settings.page.models.desc: Large language models for plugins. Only OpenAI-compatible chat/completions endpoints are required; multiple models are allowed and plugins use the default model.
settings.models.add.label: Add model
settings.models.add.desc: Use a Base URL up to /v1, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1; local Ollama can use http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1
settings.models.hint: Configuration is stored in the local settings.json and the API Key is plain text (do not store keys on a shared computer). Plugins such as translate call the default model via efto.ai.chat.
settings.models.model.label: Model
settings.models.key.placeholder: Can be empty for local services
settings.toast.dirExists: That folder is already in the list
settings.index.sources: Start menu {start} · Desktop {desktop} · Registry {registry} · Folders {dir} · System {system} · Deduplicated {dup}
settings.plugins.empty: No plugins yet. Import a plugin folder or .zip to get started.
settings.plugins.importEmptyPath: Enter a plugin folder or .zip path
settings.runtime.openFailed: Failed to open the download page:
settings.models.empty: No models yet. Click "Add" below to configure an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
settings.models.missing: Base URL or model name is missing
settings.ua.label: Universal Actions hotkey
settings.ua.desc: Select text in any app and press this hotkey to capture it and open the action menu; must differ from the launcher hotkey
settings.tool.snippets.label: Snippets
settings.tool.snippets.desc: Open snippet management from Quick Tools
settings.tool.fileBuffer.label: File buffer
settings.tool.fileBuffer.desc: Open the batch file buffer from Quick Tools
settings.tool.colorPicker.label: Color picker
settings.tool.colorPicker.desc: Pick a color anywhere on screen and copy its value (not in Quick Tools by default)
settings.tool.stickyNote.label: Sticky note
settings.tool.stickyNote.desc: Pin a new floating note on screen (not in Quick Tools by default)
settings.page.snippets.title: Snippets
settings.page.snippets.desc: Type the exact keyword to expand a snippet and paste it back into the previous window.
settings.snippets.add.label: Add snippet
settings.snippets.add.desc: Keywords cannot contain spaces; the body supports {date}, {time}, {datetime}
settings.snippets.hint: A snippet only appears when the keyword matches exactly, so it never hijacks normal app search; Enter pastes the expanded body into the previous window.
settings.snippets.empty: No snippets yet. Click Add below to create one.
settings.snippets.title: Title (optional)
settings.page.search.title: Web search
settings.page.search.desc: Type a trigger word, a space, and your text to search the web; local misses can fall back to search too.
settings.search.add.label: Add a search engine
settings.search.add.desc: The trigger cannot contain spaces; the URL must be http(s) and contain {q}
settings.search.hint: Example: trigger b with https://www.baidu.com/s?wd={q} — typing "b keyword" opens Baidu.
settings.search.fallback.label: Search the web when nothing is found locally
settings.search.fallback.desc: Only appears when apps, plugins, files, and the calculator all return nothing
settings.search.engine.label: Fallback engine
settings.search.name: Name
settings.search.empty: No search engines yet. Click Add below to create one.
settings.page.hotkeys.title: Tool hotkeys
settings.page.hotkeys.desc: Bind a dedicated global hotkey to a favorite tool and run it without opening the search box.
settings.hotkeys.hint: Defaults to Ctrl+Alt+1…7 for the tools below; leave a field blank to unbind. Click a field and press the combination to record it. Entries duplicating the launcher or Universal Actions hotkey are dropped; failed registrations are logged without affecting others.
settings.hotkeys.saved: Saved; duplicate or invalid hotkeys are ignored
actions.title: Universal Actions
actions.empty: No selected text captured. Select text in another app, then press the Universal Actions hotkey.
actions.footer: Enter to copy · Esc to close
actions.copyHint: Write to the clipboard for pasting anywhere
actions.pasteHint: Strip formatting and paste into the previous window
actions.webHint: Search the selected text in your default browser
actions.translateHint: Run the translation plugin with your default model (Settings → Model)
actions.aiHint: Open the AI plugin with the selected text
actions.openHint: Available when the content is a link or an existing file
files.title: File Buffer
files.empty: The buffer is empty. Press Tab on a file in search results to open its action menu, then choose Add to file buffer.
files.footer: Delete removes the selected item · Esc closes
settings.perm.accessibility.label: Accessibility
settings.perm.accessibility.desc: Required by window tiling, paste-to-front, and Universal Actions (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility)
settings.perm.screen.label: Screen Recording
settings.perm.screen.desc: Required by screenshots (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording)
settings.spotlight.state.label: Index status
settings.spotlight.scope.label: Search scope
settings.spotlight.hint: Uses the built-in macOS Spotlight (mdfind); nothing to install. Desktop / Documents / Downloads are searched by default; use Add folder to include others (external drives, code repos). System caches and dependency folders (node_modules, .git, ...) are always filtered out.
settings.spotlight.notReadyDesc: mdfind not found or indexing disabled
settings.tools.order.label: Panel order
settings.tools.order.desc: Drag the handle to reorder; the order is what the panel shows and how Alt+1..9 map.
settings.tools.order.dirty: Order changed — click Save to apply
